headline: LLM agents automate genomic, transcriptomic, and single-cell interpretation tasks
label: Llm Agents For Omics Analysis
summary: Natural-language LLM agents aim to make NGS, annotation, and perturbation-signature analysis accessible to non-specialists.
synthesis: The common thread is LLMs serving as an orchestration and interpretation layer over established bioinformatics outputs, not as sequence-level models. The agentic NGS system pairs Llama 3 70B with PubMed retrieval to run differential expression identification and enrichment, producing literature-backed interpretation for researchers with limited biological background. gffutilsAI offers natural-language querying of GFF annotation files built on gffutils and Strands. SigSpace summarizes drug-perturbation differential expression signatures from Tahoe-100M and is evaluated by matching blinded signatures. CASSIA, a published multi-agent system, annotates scRNA-seq cell types with interpretable output and reports accuracy gains on benchmarks and rare populations. What is new is agentic workflows coupling tool execution with retrieval and natural-language access to genomic data.
